svg.title: Tic-Tac: game 9, move 14
svg.desc: Game 9 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays X and GitHub O, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts lock b8 and e5. After 13... Xd3: X takes the upper left corner of the bottom board. It is GitHub's turn as O, in the upper left board, due by 20 Oct. Boards won: X 0, O 1.
